# Biotide

> A daily biorhythm chart and energy tracker for iPhone that tests the three cycles against how you feel, with compatibility and best days.

## What is Biotide?

Biotide draws the three classic biorhythm cycles (physical over 23 days, emotional over 28, intellectual over 33) from your birth date, then checks them against how you actually feel through a thirty-second daily check-in. It finds good days for exams, interviews, dates, races and important conversations, and shows biorhythm compatibility with the people around you. It is an independent app; biotide.app is its official website. Every page below also has a Markdown mirror at its URL plus `.md`.

<!-- Keep this file in step with the homepage: features, price, platforms, privacy. -->

## Key Features

- **Daily biorhythm chart**: physical, emotional and intellectual values for any day, drawn from your birth date, scrollable back and forward in time from a week to three months
- **Your day in words**: what to lean into and what to go easy on, with transition days (the classic "critical days") marked in advance
- **Daily check-in**: energy, mood, focus and last night's sleep, each rated 1 to 5 in about thirty seconds
- **Do the curves fit you? (Plus)**: after 14 check-ins, how often each curve matched how you felt; a curve that doesn't fit counts for less and can drop out
- **Prime days (Plus)**: the best days in the next 30, 60 or 90 days for an exam, interview, pitch, date, race, trip, creative work, big decision or important conversation, alone or with someone
- **Biorhythm compatibility (Plus)**: people added by birthday or from Contacts, a match percentage, a day-by-day view and the next good day to talk
- **Apple Health (Plus)**: sleep, heart rate variability, resting heart rate and respiratory rate compared with your own usual, never with norms; read only
- **Widgets (Plus)**: Home Screen and Lock Screen, every size
- **Platforms**: iPhone, iOS 26 or later; optional iCloud sync (Plus); no iPad or Android version
- **Availability**: not on the App Store yet; coming soon
- **Languages**: English and Ukrainian

## Cost Model

Biotide is free to download, with no ads. Free: the daily chart and readings (classic curves), the evening check-in with a reminder, transition-day notes, and export as JSON or CSV. Biotide Plus is optional: weekly, monthly or yearly (monthly and yearly with a free trial), or a one-time purchase. It adds people and compatibility, Prime days and the forecast calendar, how often each curve fits you with readings and plans tuned to it, Apple Health signals, iCloud sync and every widget. Prices are shown in the App Store before buying.

## Honesty

Biorhythm theory is not supported by research: a 1998 review of 134 studies (Hines, Psychological Reports) found the curves did no better than chance. Biotide treats them as a starting guess to test against your own check-ins, never as a prediction. It is for reflection and planning, not medical advice.

## Privacy

- No Biotide account; no servers, analytics or advertising in the app
- Birth date, check-ins and people stay on the device, or in the user's own private iCloud if they turn on sync
- Apple Health data is only read, never written, never synced and never leaves the device
- On the website, Google Analytics runs under a regional consent banner (opt-in in the EEA, opt-out elsewhere). Cookieless aggregate page-view counting (Cloudflare Web Analytics) uses no cookies or identifiers.

## Common Questions

**Q: What is a biorhythm?**
A: One of three cycles that, according to a theory popular since the 1970s, start on the day you were born: physical (23 days), emotional (28) and intellectual (33); Biotide draws all three as a daily biorhythm chart.

**Q: What are critical days in a biorhythm?**
A: The days a cycle crosses zero; Biotide calls them transition days and marks them in advance.

**Q: How does biorhythm compatibility work?**
A: Biotide compares your three cycles with another person's from both birthdays, shows a match percentage and finds the days that look good for both of you.

**Q: How is Biotide different from other biorhythm apps?**
A: Most biorhythm apps draw the curves and stop; Biotide tests them with a thirty-second evening check-in, and with Plus shows after 14 check-ins how often each curve matched how you felt, and lets the curves that don't fit count for less.

**Q: What does Biotide cost?**
A: Free to download with no ads: the chart, the reading, check-ins, reminders and export. Biotide Plus (weekly, monthly or yearly, or a one-time purchase) adds people and compatibility, Prime days and the forecast calendar, how often each curve fits you, Apple Health, iCloud sync and every widget.

**Q: Is my data private?**
A: Yes; there is no account and no server, data stays on the device or in the user's own iCloud, and Apple Health data never leaves the device.
